projectDescription: A Home Assistant custom integration framework that retrieves waste collection schedules from 600+ service providers worldwide and displays them as sensors and calendar entities.
keyFeatures: Supports 600+ waste collection service providers across 20+ countries
GUI configuration via Home Assistant Integrations UI (since v2.0.0)
Flexible sensor templates for custom display formatting
Support for generic ICS/iCal files and user-specified dates
Customizable waste types with aliases, icons, and visibility
Extensible plugin architecture for adding new service providers
publicApiSurface: Collection(date, t, icon, picture) — core data class returned by source scripts
CollectionBase — base class for collection data objects
CollectionGroup — grouped collection for same-day events
CollectionAggregator — aggregates and filters collections from multiple sources
SourceShell — wraps source scripts and applies customization
Customize — configuration object for waste type customization
Source.fetch() -> list[Collection] — interface all source scripts must implement
waste_collection_schedule.fetch_data — Home Assistant service to manually trigger updates
sensor platform: waste_collection_schedule — HA sensor platform
calendar platform: waste_collection_schedule — HA calendar platform
